test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven people, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting in a straight row, facing north. P is sitting third to the right of M. Only four people sit between Q and S. O is sitting third to the right of Q. R is sitting to the immediate left of Q. Who is sitting at the centre of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven people, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) Only four people sit between Q and S.

2) R is sitting to the immediate left of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daa4340c110504bb5f1f6818f0a0bd0fc235b8deca07284901e3c76c16094c99.png] 

3) O is sitting third to the right of Q.

4) P is sitting third to the right of M.

And, N will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16bd362c144e12659a44a33b8c89c6aa6a486f4159e31e157d72fa6e79ed476e.png] 

Here, "N" is sitting at the centre of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
